description: This file defines a set of minimal, reusable UI components styled for the Ocean Professional theme, including Button, Input, TextArea, Select, Badge, Card, Table, and Modal components, intended for use in a React project.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A styled button component supporting different variants and focus styles.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled text input component with label and error display.

methods.name: TextArea
methods.description: A styled multi-line text area with label and error display.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A styled select dropdown with label and error display.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: A small badge/pill component with theme colors.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A themed container for grouping content.

methods.name: Table

methods.name: Modal
